description: Every valuation satisfying \(\Gamma\) satisfies every clause derivable from \(\Gamma\) by resolution.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.sound.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  {Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α} {C : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Clause α}
  (d : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives Γ C) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models v Γ) : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat v C
